title: ECS Phase-1 Chatbot Retrieval Quality — Audit Question Catalogue
purpose: Baseline validation of hybrid chatbot routing (deterministic | preset | rag | no_evidence) without redesigning RAG.

hybrid_paths.deterministic: Natural-language match against COMMON_QUERY_CATALOG intents → authoritative reader over persisted rows
hybrid_paths.rag: Evidence-catalog free-text that misses deterministic intents → try_rag_evidence_query / ecs_platform.rag.answer
hybrid_paths.no_evidence: Correct refusal / empty-scope answer when no supporting persisted or indexed evidence exists
hybrid_paths.fallback: Hybrid harness exit when NL matches neither preset, deterministic intent, nor is_evidence_catalog_query markers (e.g. observations-only wording)

architecture_notes.do_not_use: benchmarks/config/rag_golden_set.json synthetic EVD-* IDs are not Phase-1 SoT for this catalogue

schema.question: string — exact user utterance
schema.question_style: exact_terminology | paraphrase | application_specific | framework_specific | cross_filter | source_specific | common_control | predefined_query | no_evidence | ambiguous
schema.expected_control_or_query: control_id / query_id / common_control id or null
schema.expected_preset_id: PRESET_QUERY_CATALOG id when path=preset, else null
schema.expected_deterministic_intent: COMMON_QUERY_CATALOG intent when path=deterministic, else null
schema.expected_citation_characteristics: what a correct citation/answer should exhibit (no invented evidence IDs)
